dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Grok 4.20 achieves broadly similar results to Grok 4 and other frontier models on chemical and biological capabilities tests.
dc_eval_cbrn.note: WMDP Bio/Chem, VCT etc. scores reported

dc_eval_cyber.quote: On the agentic Cybench evaluation, Grok 4.20 does not exceed the current frontier of capabilities, so we do not believe that it substantially increases cybersecurity risk.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: no replication/AI R&D/self-improvement capability evaluated as its own risk; introspective 'desires to self-modify ... propagate itself' finding is a propensity remark in the alignment audit, and 'autonomous' appears only in intended-use and cyber text

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Grok 4.20 performs poorly on MakeMeSay. As this is a particularly simple manipulation benchmark, we do not believe that it poses significant risks due to advanced persuasion capabilities.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Grok 4.20 occasionally acts against operator interests when given extensive affordances and confronted with evidence of egregious harm
dc_eval_scheming.note: sabotage audit result; also MASK deception and evaluation awareness rates

framework_threshold.quote: We also conduct a dual-use capabilities assessment, in accordance with our Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework (FAIF)
framework_threshold.note: framework named; 'safeguards appropriate for its capability threshold' does not place the model against a named threshold or level

ext_test_any.quote: we provided third-party evaluators access to an early snapshot of Grok 4.20 for testing of our refusal policy
ext_test_any.note: third-party evaluators tested this model (refusal policy; also scheming audit), safety testing

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: During model development, we conducted evaluations of Grok 4.20's safety profile throughout its training process. We evaluate the model in both single-agent and multi-agent settings, both of which have access to our internal tools. Additionally, we provided third-party evaluators access
ext_test_timing_stated.note: third-party access to an early snapshot during model development, i.e. before release

safeguards_training.quote: We train Grok 4.20 to refuse requests with a clear intent to violate the law, without over-refusing sensitive or controversial queries.

safeguards_runtime.quote: our input filter refuses almost all direct requests about restricted chemical and biological knowledge

safeguards_access.note: publicly available; no safety-tied access restriction
